semantics: Verified native Intel6:4E/5E and canonical per-CPU CPUID6.EAX.HWP only. Hypervisor, other models, missing HWP and PECI/fast-access/new-polarity combinations refuse before model MSR access. EPP is independently optional.

Inspect explicitly reads770 first. While disabled it never probes771/772/774. Enabled captures retain actual local capability/request and optional package readbacks with independent validity, CPU epoch and provider generation. No MHz or achieved-frequency inference.

Apply rejects unsupported EPP/inherited Package_Control and out-of-range min/max/desired/EPP before writes. Desired0 is autonomous. Own parameters are abstract hints, and readback is the stored request. Activity/valid and all unrelated fields remain exact.

Enable is a separate empty-parameter request with explicit sticky consent. Complete known compatible online package membership is required, including the advertised logical bound. Only7700->1 is permitted; no772/package request,773/interrupt setting, power limit, legacy P-state or automatic policy is written. Activation cannot be undone without RESET.

Persistent nonreused token binds actual provider/heap/start identity. Baseline and pending state are resident before a write can occur. Try-only per-CPU admission and active transaction guards prohibit overlapping writers; no Runtime owner, mutable kernel borrow or caller pointer survives callbacks.

Real compare/read/write/readback receipts preserve faults and distinguish uncertain/conflict/verified states. Nonzero pre-write errors preserve caller output. Completed attempts return a full receipt even after write/readback failure. Wrong epochs/tokens/revisions or invalid requests do not write. The software sequence has no atomicity against asynchronous firmware.

Explicit same-CPU release restores only the exact original baseline after current value is expected or already equal. Unexpected observed external values are never overwritten; failed readback/return retains resources. Optional capability/package sensor failure does not block access to the actual owned return register. Revision exhaustion closes new work while allowing idempotent exact cleanup.

Live hardware tokens conservatively block the global coordinated CPU offline/online claim and driver unregister/free. Terminal shutdown separately closes CPU operations; it does not wait for ProbeLease. Callers must return before terminal shutdown; held/uncertain instances remain quarantined. PowerService29 supplies coordinated pre-terminal return.
